home_hero_line_1: your attention is more valuable than gold in 2026
home_hero_line_2: don't give it away for free
home_intro_1: if you look at your phone for 4 hours per day, that means 5 years of your awake time is being spent in front of a screen in the next 20 years.
home_intro_2: you could be an expert at many topics using those 5 years
home_how_profile_body: iphones accept configuration profiles, the same files companies use to manage work phones. this tool builds one for you in your browser. nothing is uploaded.
home_how_websites_body: the profile turns on ios's built-in web filter with your list of blocked sites. it works in safari and in every in-app browser, on any iphone. you can remove the profile yourself in settings, so this level is a speed bump, not a wall.
home_how_apps_body: ios can hide apps by their bundle id. hidden apps can still be downloaded from the app store, but the icon never appears and they cannot open. this only works on a supervised iphone.
home_how_supervision_body: supervision is a device mode apple built for schools and companies. it makes the profile unremovable and unlocks app hiding. apple's official way to enable it erases the phone. our guide shows how to do it without losing anything, using a backup file.
home_apps_title: we recommend to block all these apps
home_apps_subtitle: you can add more or remove some.
gen_app_search_error: The App Store search did not answer. Try again in a moment.
gen_apps_empty: No apps blocked yet. Search above to add some.
gen_web_custom_help: One URL per line. Subdomains are included.
gen_web_private_browsing: Allow private tabs and clearing history
gen_allow_app_store_help: Turning it off also stops app updates; banks and airlines break. Blocking apps by name is usually better.
gen_lock_removal: Lock the profile so it cannot be removed
gen_summary_tier: On a normal iPhone this profile blocks {sites} sites. Hidden apps and the removal lock only apply after supervision.
gen_install_step_transfer: AirDrop or email the file to the iPhone.
gen_install_step_settings: Open Settings, then Profile Downloaded, then Install.
gen_install_step_reboot: Reboot if a blocked app icon lingers.
gen_install_step_unsupervised: Normal iPhone: sites are blocked right away, apps are not. To hide apps too, supervise the phone first (see the guide) and install again.
gen_install_note: Blocked apps still download from the App Store, but they stay hidden and will not open.
sup_head_title: supervise your iphone without erasing it
sup_title: supervise your iphone without erasing it
sup_lead: supervision is a device mode apple built for schools and companies. it is the only way to make a profile unremovable and to hide apps. apple's official path wipes the phone. this guide keeps your data.
sup_get_apps: apps you choose disappear and cannot open, even if they get downloaded again
sup_get_profile: the profile cannot be removed from settings
sup_get_store: the app store keeps working, so your apps keep updating
sup_get_rest: everything else on the phone stays exactly as it is: photos, messages, apps, logins
sup_cost_time: about 30 to 60 minutes, most of it waiting for a backup and a restore
sup_cost_mac: a mac with a cable (windows works with itunes but our tool is mac only for now)
sup_cost_redownload: apps re-download from the app store after the restore; a few ask you to log in again; face id needs to be set up again
sup_cost_findmy: find my iphone has to be off during the restore; you turn it back on after
sup_checklist_passcode: know your iphone passcode and your apple account password
sup_checklist_stolen: settings > face id & passcode > turn off stolen device protection (may ask you to wait an hour if you are away from a familiar location)
sup_checklist_findmy: settings > your name > find my > find my iphone > off
sup_checklist_backup: optional but recommended: settings > your name > icloud > icloud backup > back up now
sup_checklist_fulldisk: on the mac: system settings > privacy & security > full disk access > add your terminal app, then quit and reopen the terminal
sup_step1_title: step 1: back up to your mac (not encrypted)
sup_step1_plug: plug the iphone into the mac, unlock it, tap trust
sup_step1_finder: finder > your iphone > general > "back up all data on this iphone to this mac"
sup_step1_encrypt: untick "encrypt local backup" (if it asks, enter your old backup password)
sup_step1_run: click back up now. a 14 gb phone took about 9 minutes for us
sup_step1_why: why unencrypted: the tool needs to read one small file inside the backup. encrypted backups hide it. if icloud keychain is on, your saved passwords come back from icloud anyway
sup_step2_body: the backup contains a small settings file named CloudConfigurationDetails.plist. it has one switch, IsSupervised, set to false. we set it to true and keep the file exactly the same size so the backup stays valid. nothing else in the backup changes.
sup_step2_download: download the tool with the first line below
sup_step2_check: check lists your backups: device, ios version, encrypted yes/no, current flag
sup_step2_patch: patch shows the change, asks for confirmation, and keeps an untouched copy of the file next to your backups
sup_step2_unpatch: unpatch undoes the change, as long as you have not restored yet
sup_step2_commands:
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mertbuilds/keepyourattention/main/cli/supervise.py
python3 supervise.py check
python3 supervise.py patch
python3 supervise.py unpatch

sup_step3_restore: finder > your iphone > restore backup > pick the backup you just made > restore
sup_step3_reboot: the iphone reboots, shows an "upgrade" screen, asks for your passcode, then lands on the home screen
sup_step3_settings: open settings. the top of the page should read "this iphone is supervised"
sup_step3_verify: optional: verify asks the connected iphone itself (needs apple configurator from the mac app store)
sup_step4_findmy: turn find my iphone back on
sup_step4_faceid: set up face id again if asked
sup_step4_apps: wait for the greyed-out app icons to finish downloading (wifi helps)
sup_step4_profile: install your keepyourattention profile from the generator: airdrop the file, settings > profile downloaded > install. blocked apps vanish, sites are blocked, the profile shows as unremovable
sup_verified_row_result: supervised, all data kept, 5 hidden apps removed by cable afterwards
sup_verified_earlier: earlier community reports: ios 15, 16 (ask different, 2023), ios 17 encrypted via imazing (2024)
sup_trouble_permission_term: "operation not permitted" when the tool runs
sup_trouble_permission_desc: the terminal lacks full disk access. grant it, quit and reopen the terminal
sup_trouble_encrypted_term: the tool says the backup is encrypted
sup_trouble_encrypted_desc: untick "encrypt local backup" in finder and back up again
sup_trouble_unsupervised_desc: the restore probably used a different backup. run check, confirm IsSupervised is true on the backup you restore, retry
sup_trouble_undo_desc: settings > general > transfer or reset > erase all content and settings removes supervision. restore from your icloud backup afterwards. this is the only way apple gives to leave supervision
sup_notes_unsupported: this is not an apple supported procedure. it uses the backup format, which apple can change. it works on ios 26.6.1 today
sup_notes_organization: supervising with a mac and no company mdm means the phone is "supervised by" whoever ran the tool; the organization name shows empty
sup_notes_roadmap: a windows version, and encrypted backup support, are on the list
sup_alt_nomac: no mac: tech lockdown sells a windows/mac tool that does the same in a few clicks, as part of a paid plan
sup_alt_nosupervision: no supervision: the generator's website blocking works on any iphone right away; only the app hiding and the removal lock need supervision
sup_alt_erase: erase path: if you do not mind starting fresh, apple configurator's "prepare" with "supervise devices" ticked, then set the phone up as new
